Visa Application Steps
STEP 1: Send email to our offices, call the numbers above to consult us first, requesting quote, sample visa form and empty form, as well as detailed instruction. Please use below email template:
Dear Visa Staff,
We are xxx, xxx, total (number) people. We are US （or other counties）citizens, and currently on xx visa / green card in the US. We have (not) applied visa to xxxx country before. We live in xxxx. My phone number is: xxxxxxx.
We plan to visit xxxx country for purpose of tour (business, work, visit families, etc). Please provide us a quote, instructions and visa application forms.
Thanks,
STEP 2: Fill in the form, print and sign (please save your filled form and email back to us to facilitate editing). Bring all necessary documents to us according to the instruction, usually including: passport, photos, application form, other supporting documents, payment of cash or check. Boston office and New York Office provide high quality passport photo services.
Or mail to:
Boston Office: AET, 6 Pleasant Street, Suite 418, Malden, MA 02148
New York Office:60-20 Woodside Ave, Suite 205, Queens NY 11377
Los Angeles Office:17802 Sky Park Cir, Suite 205 A, IRVINE, CA 92614-6403, United States
Miami Office:15321 South Dixie Hwy, Suite 302,Palmetto Bay, FL 33157
STEP 3: Pick up your visa at our offices, or receive mails back to you.

Visa application steps
1. Send email to our offices or call any numbers above to consult us first, requesting quote, sample Information collection form, as well as detailed instruction.
Email address:
Boston Office:visa.aetb@gmail.com
New York Office:nycaet.certificate@gmail.com

6. Proof of Relationship
7. Travel plan
8. Other documents can proof of your identity (US Driver License, Proof of attendance, Job offer letter, I797, I20, etc.)

sections.title: Schengen Visa
sections.html:
*Attention: Interview may be required for the Schengen visas
Which countries issue Schengen Visa?
Northern Europe: Iceland, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland
Southern Europe: Slovenia, Greece, Italy, Malta, Spain, Portugal
Western Europe: Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, France
Central Europe: Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein
Eastern Europe: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania

Processing time
At least 6 months prior to your trip. Processing time may vary for different countries.

Who is eligible to apply
Applicant should have valid long-term visa (F/H1B/M visa, etc.) or permanent residency in the US.

Which countries should I apply for?
Depend on your first destination country or the country you will spend most of the time. Please contact us for more information.

AET Service fee
${{visa:schengenService}}/person (Normal service).
Clients need to pay for visa fee from consulate, documents deliver fee and insurance fee.

Visa fee to consulate
The fee may vary by countries. Please contact us for more information.

1. Send email to our offices or call any numbers above to consult us first, requesting quote, sample Information collection form, as well as detailed instruction.

New York Office:nycaet.certificate@gmail.com

Miami Office:info@aet21.com/info@americantranslationservice.com
2. Fill in the information collection form and make a payment. Then we start to process your application.
3. Check everything before your interview.
4. Pick up the visa after the approval notice.

Application documents

2. Vaild US Visa or Permanente residence (At least 3 month validation )
